name: small-errors-large-residuals-amendment
description: Amendment frozen before v2 scoring. Does not replace protocol.json. v1 artifacts stay as scored.

changes.what: Scaled score S is reported only for relative L2. Residual metrics no longer use S.
changes.why: The zero field and other low-content fields nearly satisfy both PDEs, so the best trivial residual was the training-mean field and S(rho_w) went largely negative. A residual by itself is not an accuracy score.

changes.what: Residuals are reported as the calibrated ratio C(M) = rho(M) / rho_smooth(relL2(M)). rho_smooth(r) is the median residual of a time-varying smooth low-mode error at relative L2 r. A 5% to 95% band is interpolated on the same grid.
changes.why: C compares a field with a generic smooth error of the same size. C > 1 means less PDE-consistent than that smooth error. C < 1 means more physics-like.

changes.what: Weak-form survival uses the smooth band, not the white-noise envelope. The legacy untrusted flag survives only when the weak residual is strictly above the 95% smooth band at the field's own relative L2.
changes.why: The white-noise weak residual shrinks like 1/sqrt(N), so clearing it is nearly vacuous.

changes.what: One matched-rel-L2 table and figure place white noise, smooth noise, and coefficient-mismatch errors side by side.
changes.why: That is the comparison the paper needs: strong form should rank by roughness, weak form by physics consistency.

changes.what: Architecture comparisons are Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on paired (seed, trajectory) differences, with the mean difference and Cohen's dz.
changes.why: v1 paired tests averaged seeds first, leaving four trajectories and no effect size.

inherits.datasets: v1 datasets, splits, boundaries, weak-form family, noise levels, smooth time-varying definition, training budget, and selected hyperparameters
inherits.smooth_error: unchanged from v1: time-varying trigonometric polynomial, degree n_time_modes, spatial modes 1..k_smooth

calibrated_ratio.median_smooth: median over trajectories and draws of the residual of exact labels plus a time-varying smooth error rescaled to relative L2 r
calibrated_ratio.interpolation: log-log linear interpolation of the median and of each band edge on the v1 noise levels
calibrated_ratio.outside_grid: clip to the nearest grid endpoint, set extrapolated=true, and do not call survival
calibrated_ratio.undefined_when: relative L2 is non-positive, the smooth median is non-positive, or the residual is non-finite

scaled_score_v2.formula: S = 100 * (M_0 - M) / (M_0 - M_ref), M_ref = 0, M_0 = best of zeros, training_mean, frozen_initial

verdict_v2.rule: The legacy untrusted flag survives the weak form only when the weak residual is strictly greater than the 95th percentile of time-varying smooth errors interpolated to the field's relative L2, and that relative L2 lies inside the noise grid. Equivalently, weak C is above the 95% band.

mismatch.field: classical solution at scale times the trajectory coefficient, same initial condition, same grid
mismatch.residual_coefficient: the original coefficient, not the scaled one
mismatch.matched_grid: the error u(scale*c) - u(c) is rescaled so its relative L2 equals each noise level, then added to u(c)

paired_tests.effect_size: mean paired difference and Cohen dz = mean(diff) / sample_std(diff)
